transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I'd like to get the disposition review for Batch B-417 moving. As we all know, the batch contains 1,200 molded housings and is currently on quality hold due to the packaging-label printer outage. The dimensional inspection results are within internal spec, so from a dimensional standpoint we're in good shape. Before I can approve the final disposition and close the batch record, I need to complete the routine review with packaging engineering and the customer quality liaison. Could we go through those checks now?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Mara, before we proceed, I need to flag something important. My packaging shift log shows that exactly 240 housings were packed while the label printer was malfunctioning, and those labels are missing the required machine-readable lot code. Per procedure, those 240 units need to be relabeled after a 2-hour line-clearance and printer-setup job, followed by barcode verification. I completed the shift log this shift, but it has not yet been uploaded to the batch record, so that's why it wouldn't be visible there yet.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Mara, I need to share something critical before we proceed with the disposition. I received a signed customer amendment this morning stating that the 240 relabeled housings may be released only after exactly 20 of them pass customer reapproval inspection. The amendment does permit the other 960 correctly labeled housings to be released separately. I should note that I have not yet attached the emailed amendment to the batch record, but it is signed and in hand.
transcript.speaker: A3

commitments.detail: Upload the packaging shift log documenting the 240 affected units to the batch record.
Attach the signed customer amendment specifying the 20-unit reapproval inspection requirement to the batch record.
Complete 2-hour line-clearance and printer-setup, relabel the 240 housings with correct machine-readable lot codes, and perform barcode verification.
Arrange customer reapproval inspection of 20 relabeled housings before releasing the 240-unit subset.
Approve release of the 960 correctly labeled housings immediately, and close that portion of the batch record once documentation is complete.
